messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Even though I have washed my hands on multiple occasions since thenI think she ate a lot of garlic ( smells hands ).

output.original_text: Even though I have washed my hands on multiple occasions since then, I think she ate a lot of garlic (smells hands).
output.joy: Even though I’ve washed my hands so many times since then, I can’t help but laugh—she must have eaten a ton of garlic! (smells hands)
output.sadness: Even though I’ve washed my hands countless times since then, it’s sad to think she ate so much garlic. (smells hands)
output.fear: Even though I washed my hands several times since then, I’m worried she might have eaten a lot of garlic. (smells hands)
output.anger: Even after washing my hands multiple times since then, I can’t believe she thought it was okay to eat so much garlic! (smells hands)
output.surprise: I can’t believe it! Even after washing my hands so many times since then, she must have really overloaded on garlic! (smells hands)
output.disgust: Even though I’ve washed my hands repeatedly since then, I can’t stand the thought that she ate all that garlic! (smells hands)
